name: hud_ui_mgr_objective_start_hide
description: HudUiMgrObjective::StartHide advances the objective panel hide/show animation phases, updates slide and meter geometry, invalidates active panels, runs auto-hide, and completes the hide transition.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The smoke keeps the active HUD type at standard mode for the phase-3 completion branch; the hardware dirty-rect callee is covered separately by hud_layout_hw_update_objective_dirty_rect.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation at 0x411ac0 show unscaled delta accumulation, phase-1 slide interpolation and completion, phase-2 invalidation, phase-3 reverse slide/completion, widget-right update, meter-point update, sensor-noise call, hardware dirty-rect gate through zOpt::GetHudTypeForCurrentHwMode, visibility changes, gAltClipPassEnabled restoration, and auto-hide Begin dispatch.

The native HUD objective smoke verifies phase-1 in-progress slide math, phase-1 completion visibility, phase-2 invalidation with auto-hide Begin transition, and phase-3 completion state reset, widget position/right-edge update, bar hide, sensor overlay show, and alt-clip restoration.
